{{Top|leg}}
The '''Imperial Classified Flight Yards''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-owned testing center which dealt with the development and testing of experimental starfighters. At some point before [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], then-[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]] was temporarily stationed at the Flight Yards, with his brief time having him test-flying the [[TIE/ag "Aggressor" Starfighter/Legends|TIE/AG Aggressor starfighter]], the [[TIE/hu "Hunter" Multi-Role Starfighter|TIE/HU Hunter multi-role starfighter]], the [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defender]], and the [[TIE/ph "Phantom" Multi-Role Stealth Starfighter/Legends|TIE/ph phantom]], and likewise gave their basic statistics in the ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'', the official field manual for the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]].
